title: Patterns in Pascal's Triangle mod p^k for k > 1

problemStatement.formal: For prime p and k <= n, p^m divides Nat.choose n k iff m <= carryCount p n k; in particular prime-power Pascal rows have interior entries divisible by p, and zero carries imply coprimality to p.
problemStatement.plain: Characterize divisibility patterns in Pascal's triangle modulo prime powers using the carry count from Kummer's theorem.
whyMatters: Kummer's carry criterion explains the arithmetic pattern behind Pascal triangle residues modulo prime powers.
The record connects the parent Kummer proof to concrete row and carry-free divisibility corollaries.

proven: choose_dvd_prime_pow_iff characterizes p^m divisibility by the carry count.
pascal_row_prime_power_div proves interior entries in a p^n row are divisible by p.
choose_prime_div and choose_prime_sq_div provide prime and prime-square row corollaries.
choose_coprime_of_no_carries proves the carry-free coprimality criterion.
